payload.text:
Hubble's eXtreme Deep Field: one tiny patch of sky, a small fraction of the width of the full Moon, holds about 5,500 galaxies. Hubble stared at it for a total of 50 days over 10 years, and some of the light set off 13.2 billion years ago.

Source:
NASA Science, Hubble Goes to the eXtreme to Assemble Farthest Ever View of the Universe: https://science.nasa.gov/missions/hubble/hubble-goes-to-the-extreme-to-assemble-farthest-ever-view-of-the-universe/

Image: NASA / ESA / G. Illingworth, D. Magee, P. Oesch, R. Bouwens and the HUDF09 Team. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
